items.title: Nvidia's Board Prepares to Oust Jensen Huang
items.take: Today's rotation pick, out early this morning, is the story: per the reporting, Nvidia's board is preparing to remove the CEO at the center of the spy-scandal affair reports. If it moves today, expect volatility well beyond the stock, given how heavily Nvidia weighs on the indexes.

items.title: Stock market today: Nvidia slides following reports of CEO's second affair, possible removal
items.take: Wednesday's session was a chip revival: CoreWeave surged 25% on an upbeat outlook, Nvidia bounced 2.9% after shedding about $430 billion of market value over two days, and the S&P and Nasdaq each gained more than 1%. Then after the bell came a second affair report, an independent board investigation into whether the woman involved was a Chinese spy, and the after-hours slide.

items.title: US stocks rally, then Nvidia turmoil jolts futures
items.take: Nvidia fell more than 8% in after-hours trading, and a source told Reuters the board was meeting to decide the CEO's future, with no decision reported yet. Nasdaq 100 futures later fell more than 1% and S&P contracts lost 0.5%. Also circling: Anthropic's IPO next week, 825 million shares at $70 to $78, a range that could value the company at up to $1.4 trillion.

items.title: US stocks rally as CoreWeave surges 25%, Nvidia rebounds; S&P 500, Nasdaq gain over 1%
items.take: Semiconductors led Wednesday: Nvidia +2.9%, Micron +11.9%, AMD +7.3%, Broadcom +4%, on thin Veterans Day volume with fixed-income markets closed. Traders are now fully pricing at least a 25-basis-point December hike, with a 10.4% probability of a 50-basis-point move per CME FedWatch.

items.title: Chip Revival: CoreWeave Sparks Fresh Tech Rally
items.take: Futures trading now factors 50-basis-point December odds at just 15%, with a range of 4.5% to 4.75% by next June the most likely scenario, implying 75 basis points of tightening between now and mid-year. Memory and storage names were especially strong, with SanDisk up 13.7% and Seagate nearly 10%.
